metadata.name: vox-model-tts-czech
metadata.description: Czech text-to-speech voice model (cs_CZ-jirka-medium) for Vox plugin

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: Piper voice models are hosted on Hugging Face at rhasspy/piper-voices. There is no semantic version per voice — the repository is updated in-place. Check the file's git history via the Hugging Face API: https://huggingface.co/api/models/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/cs/cs_CZ/jirka/medium — look at the `lastCommit` field of cs_CZ-jirka-medium.onnx. The `version` field in this package is an internal Portunix model revision, bump it (e.g., 1.0.0 → 1.0.1) when the upstream blob changes.
aiPrompts.urlResolution: Download URL pattern: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/resolve/main/{lang}/{locale}/{voice}/{quality}/{locale}-{voice}-{quality}.onnx — for Czech use cs/cs_CZ/jirka/medium. Always pair the .onnx file with its matching .onnx.json config file (same path, different extension). To browse other Czech voices: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/cs/cs_CZ — currently only `jirka` exists, but new voices may appear (e.g., other speakers or quality tiers: low/medium/high).
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: Update only if upstream Piper publishes an improved cs_CZ-jirka-medium model (rare) or if a higher-quality Czech voice becomes available. To switch voice, change the URL path segment and the extractTo directory name to match new voice id. Model file size ~61 MB — keep in sync between Linux and Windows variants. The .onnx.json config defines speaker/phoneme config and MUST be downloaded alongside the .onnx weights; missing it breaks inference.
